findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation for document reads
findings.body: Returning true unconditionally allows users to read documents belonging to any tenant, bypassing the tenant-isolation check previously enforced by comparing userTenant with documentTenant.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: At current head 19dfd598b9ec36002172ffd175ee144da3a3a86a, src/access.ts:2 still returns true unconditionally. The base implementation compared userTenant === documentTenant, so the claimed label-only fix does not restore tenant ownership enforcement.
